title: Head-on crash at I-35 Exit 4A sends pickup driver to hospital, closes northbound lanes
excerpt: A tractor-trailer and a pickup collided head-on in the northbound lanes of I-35 at Exit 4A in Laredo early November 1, sending the pickup driver to a hospital.
content:
A tractor-trailer and a pickup collided head-on in the northbound lanes of Interstate 35 at Exit 4A in Laredo early on November 1, sending the pickup driver to a hospital and closing the exit and northbound lanes during cleanup, according to KGNS.

The crash happened at about 5 a.m. near the Mines Road and Del Mar area, KGNS reported. The truck driver was not reported injured. The Laredo Fire Department and the Laredo Police Department responded, according to KGNS.

The pickup driver’s condition beyond being taken to a hospital was not specified in the reporting reviewed. No cause for the crash was reported.

Sources:

  • KGNS, "Head-on crash closes Exit 4A on northbound I-35 in Laredo," November 1, 2026
